newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy to sell Texas natgas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy to sell Texas natgas pipeline.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said that it signed a letter of intent to sell its Texas intrastate natural gas pipeline system for $28 million in cash to a partnership consisting of an affiliate of MCN Energy Group Inc and Copano Field Services LLC.

Under the terms, KCS Energy would sell its Texas intrastate natural gas pipeline system located north of Houston, together with related marketing assets and a joint venture gathering system in Grimes County, Texas.
With the sale of the pipeline system, KCS said it would focuse on its core oil and gas exploration and production business.
The company will use the proceeds from the sale of the pipeline system to fund a portion of its 1997 capital budget, currently set at $160 million."

KCS Energy is an independent energy company primarily engaged in the acquisition, exploration, development and production of natural gas and crude oil, with operations in the Rocky Mountains, the Onshore Gulf Coast and the Mid-Continent region.
